descriptionHTML:
Sadiq is a beautifully designed app trusted by Muslims worldwide to make every Ibadah more meaningful. Stay connected to Allah and maximise your worship. Completely free & no ads.

🕰️ Get precise prayer times
- Accurate timings for all five daily prayers and voluntary prayers like Dhuha and Tahajjud, based on your location no matter whetherr you are.
- Pick your calculation method for accurate Salah timings
- See the forbidden prayer times at a glance
- Track daily Salah with the home screen prayer widget

🔔 Never miss a prayer
- Get clear Adhan notifications and beautiful prayer sounds for every Salah.
- Reliable reminders help you stay on track with your daily prayers wherever you are. You can also customize the notification sound.

📖 Connect deeper with the Quran
- Read with translations in multiple languages
- Listen to famous Qaris, and access word-by-word meanings.
- Recite in Mushaf mode for distraction free tilawah.

🏆 Live with a mission, set goals & track progress
- Become a better Muslim by setting a meaningful mission, creating achievable goals, and tracking your progress.
- Every small step brings you closer to a life that pleases Allah and benefits you in the Hereafter.

📿 Learn authentic Dua & Adhkar
- Sunnah Duas in 15+ categories with audio and translations.

🧭 Track fasting times
- Get exact Suhur and Iftar timings.
- Never miss a fast with accurate schedules and reminders.

🕋 Find Qibla Direction
- Accurate Kaaba direction in seconds, wherever you are.

📅 Islamic Calendar
- Track Islamic events and dates with integrated Hijri and Gregorian calendars.
- Adjust your preferred Hijri calendar by adding or subtracting days.

🕌 Find nearby Mosque
- Easily locate mosques around you for prayer.

✳️ So much more to love
- Daily Ayah & Dua
- 99 Names of Allah
- Bookmark favourite verses
- Light/dark themes
- Multi-language support (English, Bangla, Arabic, Urdu, Indonesian, German, French, Russian, Persian, Turkish)
- Share verses as images

Download this Islamic prayer app and start your journey to deepen your connection with Allah today!

Share and recommend this beautiful Muslim companion app to your friends and family. May Allah bless us in this world and the hereafter.

Allah’s Messenger ﷺ said: "Whoever calls people to right guidance will have a reward like that of those who follow him..." [Sahih Muslim: 2674]

Developed by Greentech Apps Foundation
Website: https://gtaf.org

Please keep us in your sincere prayers. Jazakumullahu Khair.
summary: Your all-in-one Islamic companion: prayer times, Quran, Dua, Qibla, and more
